description: This file defines a class for configuring and transforming requests/responses for Azure OpenAI API responses, including URL construction, request validation, and response handling.

classes.name: AzureOpenAIResponsesAPIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Azure OpenAI responses API, including URL construction, request validation, and response processing.

methods.name: custom_llm_provider
methods.description: Returns the LlmProviders enum value for Azure.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates the environment headers and model for Azure.

methods.name: get_stripped_model_name
methods.description: Removes specific substrings from the model name.

methods.name: _handle_reasoning_item
methods.description: Filters out 'status' field from reasoning items and ensures required fields.

methods.name: _validate_input_param
methods.description: Filters out 'status' field from input message items.

methods.name: transform_responses_api_request
methods.description: Prepares the API request parameters, including model name.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the complete URL for the API request.

methods.name: _construct_url_for_response_id_in_path
methods.description: Builds URL with response ID in the path.

methods.name: transform_delete_response_api_request
methods.description: Creates URL and data for deleting a response.

methods.name: transform_get_response_api_request
methods.description: Creates URL and data for retrieving a response.

methods.name: transform_list_input_items_request
methods.description: Creates URL and parameters for listing input items.

methods.name: transform_cancel_response_api_request
methods.description: Creates URL and data for canceling a response.

methods.name: transform_cancel_response_api_response
methods.description: Transforms raw response into ResponsesAPIResponse object.
